text: 有个疑问，前几年如日中天的号称娱乐圈纪检委的某著名富二代，到处送奢侈品泡女网红，按法律来讲这就是pc，人直接打明牌，按理说一抓一个准，但从没有人管过调查过，都觉得这是正常的，这说明了什么问题呢

By law this is soliciting prostitutes, and he played it completely openly — by rights, one catch would nail him every time. text: 我问了下deepseek这个问题，连他都无法反驳，以下是deepseek知乎风格的回答：

text: 问题核心：为什么“零售”嫖娼坐牢，“批发”包养逍遥？

en: One-sentence answer: the current law's formalistic definition of 'prostitution and soliciting' and its enforcement dilemmas perfectly create the absurd situation of 'cracking down hard on individual clients while tacitly permitting yearly arrangements', exposing the serious incoherence of legal logic and the embarrassment of selective enforcement.

text: 荒谬性集中体现在三点：
en: The absurdity is concentrated in three points:

text: 本质相同，待遇天差地别！
en: Same essence, vastly different treatment!

text: “严打零售，默许批发”的现状，本质是：
